title: Quick-Fix Silky Malaysian Cabbage Fritters
description: A quick and easy Malaysian-inspired dish made with shredded white cabbage, served on a tava or griddle. This recipe excludes added sugars and is suitable for sugar-free diets.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the shredded cabbage, all-purpose flour, eggs, grated ginger, red pepper flakes, and salt. Mix well until a smooth batter forms.
Heat 1-2 tablespoons of vegetable oil in a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the cabbage mixture into the pan and flatten slightly.
Cook the fritters for 3-4 minutes on the first side, or until the edges start to curl and the surface is dry.
Flip the fritters and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy.
Repeat with the remaining cabbage mixture, greasing the pan with additional oil as needed.
Serve the fritters hot with green onions on top, garnished with a drizzle of your favorite sauce or stir-fry.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
To reheat, place the fritters on a tava or griddle over medium heat and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side, or until crispy and hot through.
